name: agent-governance-hooks
description: Governance hooks for coding agents: block destructive SQL/deletes and secret exfiltration, keep delegation scoped, optionally require typed subagent reports (return-contract), warn subagents before their turn cap, log delegations (turn-budget, delegation-log), inject critical lessons, gate 'done' on verified evidence, keep always-loaded instructions within budget, and (opt-in) nudge a project-memory update after many-file sessions (doc-touch-gate).
